description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets (plan prevention) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 428 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Plan de prévention des risques PPRN mouvement de terrain du Pays d'Iss; Plan de Prévention des Risques Naturels (PPRN) Mouvements de terrain d; Plan de prévention des risques PPRN mouvement de terrain du Boischaut ; Plan de prévention des risques de mouvements de terrain de Granville. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
